perfil_profesional: Electromechanical engineer, master's in mechanical engineering, and Ph.D. in Engineering. His field of research is computational flow dynamics, mainly for aerodynamics focused on the energy performance of rotors used for aerial transport and wind turbines. He is also interested in using biomass as an alternative energy source and the Waste-to-Energy concept through thermochemical and biological methods.
